{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how many times -999.0 appears in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
baseline_sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
followup_sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum()

print(f"Number of -999.0 in baseline: {baseline_sentinel_count}")
print(f"Number of -999.0 in follow-up: {followup_sentinel_count}")

# Check if any row has both baseline and follow-up as -999.0
both_sentinel = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)

print(f"Rows with both baseline and follow-up as -999.0: {both_sentinel.sum()}")"}
